tools.name: find_casinos
tools.description: Search the OnchainGambler.io index of crypto casinos. Filter by accepted token (symbol or name, e.g. 'USDT', 'Solana'), blockchain, KYC level and feature. Results are sorted by editorial rating.

tools.name: get_casino
tools.description: Full data sheet for one casino: rating, KYC policy, license, accepted tokens and chains, features, bonus, pros and cons.

tools.name: compare_casinos
tools.description: Head-to-head comparison of two casinos across rating, privacy, token and chain coverage, features and track record.

tools.name: list_options
tools.description: Lists the tokens, blockchains, KYC levels and features that can be used as filters.
